Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by the incorrect cleanup method, which sets the ThreadLocal variable to null instead of removing it with remove(). This can lead to memory leaks as the reference may persist.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method which executes the incorrectCleanup method, setting a ThreadLocal variable to null instead of removing it. This leads to a potential memory leak.
